answer: A concrete defense is stratified re-execution audits. The work ledger is split into meadow plots of similar tasks; each epoch auditors sample one plot at random and re-run those jobs on independent hardware. The delta between submitted and fresh output is compared deterministically: within tolerance passes, while any hollow result, citing compute never spent or unreproducible, fails and burns epoch rewards. A sybil farmer padding fake entries widens its sampled surface with each addition, so every puppet risks audit, while honest work reproduces and passes.
